intro: FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor gym equipment across Arunachal Pradesh, from Itanagar and Naharlagun in the foothills to district towns higher in the hills. Our Fun Fitness machines are made at our factory in Vasai, near Mumbai, and reach the state by road through Assam. Our installation team or a dealer in the region then fixes each station on your site, grouted or self-standing depending on the ground. Pasighat and the other towns of the river valleys have more flat land, which allows a longer row of stations.

Typical buyers here are government departments, schools, colleges and town planning bodies that want a free place for people to exercise in the open. In a hill town the hardest part is usually finding level ground. Send us photos and rough measurements of the plot, even if it is only a narrow strip beside a road. We will suggest machines that fit and mark the clear space each one needs.

sections.h: Planning an open gym for hills and long monsoons
sections.html:
Arunachal Pradesh has long, heavy monsoons, and the foothill towns stay humid for much of the year. Higher places such as Tawang and Bomdila turn cold in winter and can see snow. Our frames are galvanised pipe, which resists rust in wet weather, and they carry a 3-year warranty. Bearings and springs carry 1 year, so plan a quick check of the moving parts after every monsoon.

On a sloping site, cut a level terrace for each station rather than one large platform, and add a drain on the uphill side. Compact machines such as the Fun Walker Single and the Seating Twister Single suit small terraces. For a children's area on the same site, see our playground equipment in Arunachal Pradesh.

faq.q: Can you deliver outdoor gym equipment to towns in Arunachal Pradesh?
faq.a: Yes. We dispatch from our Vasai factory by road and install through our own team or a dealer in the region. Tell us the town and how the site is reached, because some hill roads limit the size of truck that can get through.

faq.q: Which outdoor gym machines need the least space?
faq.a: Single stations such as the Fun Walker Single, Leg Lift Post and Standing Twister Single take the least room. Share the plot size and we will show the clear area around each one on a layout drawing.

faq.q: Does an open air gym need power or a trainer?
faq.a: Neither. Every machine works on the user's own body weight, so there is nothing to plug in or set up before use. A short sign at the entrance explaining each station helps first-time users get started.

intro: Parks, river-front walkways, tea estate colonies and housing societies in Assam all make good sites for an outdoor gym, and FunPlay supplies the machines for them. Every station uses the person's own body weight, so it suits walkers, students and senior citizens alike. We build our Fun Fitness range at our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, and send it to Assam by road. Our own installation team or a dealer in the region fixes the stations, on a grouted or self-standing base to suit the ground.

Buyers differ from one part of the state to another. In Guwahati and Dispur they are mostly housing societies, schools and city parks. Upper Assam adds tea estates and the oil towns around Digboi and Duliajan, where company townships run their own parks and clubs. In the Barak valley, schools and colleges in Silchar often have open grounds where a row of stations can sit beside a walking track. Jorhat, Tezpur and Dibrugarh have colleges and municipal parks that follow the same pattern on a smaller scale.

sections.h: Rain, floods and choosing the site
sections.html:
Assam gets heavy rain through the monsoon, and parts of the Brahmaputra valley flood most years. Pick the highest corner of your ground for the gym, raise the base a little and give it a slope so water runs off. Our galvanised frames handle the humidity well, and roto-moulded seats and grips do not rust.

For a society or estate colony, a good first set is the Tai Chi Double for older residents, the Chest Press Double and a Fun Rower. Each station stands on its own base, so you can add more later. Guwahati buyers can also see our outdoor gym page for Guwahati, and for children there is our playground equipment in Assam.

faq.q: Do you supply outdoor gym equipment to tea estates in Assam?
faq.a: Yes. Estate managers can send us the size of the ground in the staff colony and the number of people likely to use it. We suggest a set of machines and send a layout drawing before you place an order.

faq.q: Will the machines rust in Assam's humid weather?
faq.a: The frames are galvanised pipe and the seats and grips are roto-moulded plastic, both chosen to resist rust. Frames carry a 3-year warranty and bearings carry 1 year when the equipment is maintained as per our instructions.

faq.q: How do I get a quote for a park in Assam?
faq.a: Call our sales team on +91 902 830 2266 or email sales@funplaysystems.com with photos of the site, its rough size and the town. We reply with suggested machines and a layout.

intro: FunPlay Systems makes outdoor gym equipment for parks, schools, colleges and housing societies in Bihar. Every Fun Fitness machine is built at our factory in Vasai, near Mumbai, which has been running since 2002. We send the equipment to Bihar by road, and our installation team or a dealer in the region sets it up on your ground. Our factory has 150+ employees covering design, fabrication and quality inspection.

We supply all parts of the state, from Patna and the towns along the Ganga to Gaya, Sasaram, Dehri, Buxar and Arrah in the south and west. Town parks and school grounds are the most common sites. Many towns also have young people training every morning for police and defence recruitment tests, and a few pull-up and parallel bar stations in a public ground get used every day. Housing societies in Patna, on the other hand, usually want gentler machines for residents of all ages.

sections.h: Machines and bases for Bihar's summers and winters
sections.html:
Bihar summers are hot, with dry winds in May and June, and winter mornings are cold and foggy. Plan the gym where trees or a shed give shade in the afternoon, since metal handles get hot in direct sun. North Bihar floods in the monsoon, so a raised, grouted base works better there than bare soil.

For a recruitment training ground, the Pull Up Station and the Parallel Bar are the usual choices. Parks with older walkers do better with a Leg Press and a Tai Chi wheel, which are easy on the knees. Gaya buyers can see our outdoor gym page for Gaya, and schools adding a play area can look at our playground equipment in Bihar.

faq.q: Which outdoor gym machines suit young people training for physical tests?
faq.a: The Pull Up Station, Parallel Bar and Leg Press are good for strength work, and they take heavy daily use. We can place them next to an existing running track so training stays in one area.

faq.q: Can you install outdoor gym equipment in smaller towns in Bihar?
faq.a: Yes. We deliver by road from Vasai to any town in the state. Our team or a dealer near you installs the stations, grouted or self-standing depending on the ground.

faq.q: What warranty comes with your outdoor gym equipment?
faq.a: Galvanised pipes and roto-moulded parts carry 3 years, and springs, bearings and spare parts carry 1 year. The warranty covers manufacturing defects when the machines are installed and maintained as we advise.

intro: Chandigarh was planned in sectors, and almost every sector has its own green belt and neighbourhood parks. That makes the city a natural fit for open air gyms, and FunPlay supplies the machines for them. Our Fun Fitness range is built at our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, sent to Chandigarh by road and installed by our team or a dealer in the north. Each station uses the person's own body weight and needs no power supply.

Buyers in the city are usually residents' welfare associations, schools, colleges, government offices and the municipal corporation. We also supply the rest of the tricity, including Panchkula and Mohali, where newer group housing societies plan a gym corner near the clubhouse. Tell us the size of the park and who will use it most, such as morning walkers, senior citizens or students, and we will suggest a set of stations. Because each machine sits on its own base, a park can start small and grow the gym over a few years.

sections.h: Planning for Chandigarh's hot summers and cold winters
sections.html:
Summers in Chandigarh are hot and dry, and winter mornings can be close to freezing with fog. People still come out early in both seasons, so place the gym near the main walking path and away from parked cars. Galvanised frames and roto-moulded parts cope with both extremes, and a grouted base keeps each station firm on the city's park lawns.

Popular stations for sector parks include the Fun Cycle, the Twister Three Way and a Shoulder Press Double. Panchkula buyers can see our outdoor gym page for Panchkula, and for children in the same park there is our playground equipment in Chandigarh.

faq.q: Can a residents' welfare association order outdoor gym equipment directly?
faq.a: Yes. Send us the park dimensions and a few photos, and we will suggest machines and send a layout and quote. Many associations start with four or five stations and add more in a later year.

faq.q: Do you install outdoor gyms in Mohali and Panchkula as well?
faq.a: Yes. We cover the whole tricity, including the newer sectors and housing projects on the edges of Mohali and Panchkula. The equipment travels by road from our Vasai factory and our team or a local dealer installs it.

faq.q: Which machines are safe for senior citizens in a sector park?
faq.a: Low-impact stations such as the Fun Cycle, Tai Chi wheel and seated twisters are easy on the joints and need no adjustment. Place them close to benches so people can rest between exercises.

intro: FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor gym equipment to townships, schools, colleges and city parks across Chhattisgarh. We have been making play and fitness equipment since 2002. We make the Fun Fitness range at our own factory in Vasai, near Mumbai, and send it to Chhattisgarh by road. Our installation team or a dealer in central India fixes the stations on site, using a grouted or self-standing base. Every machine is checked at our in-house quality inspection before dispatch.

The state has a mix of buyers that you do not see everywhere. Bhilai and Durg have the steel plant township, and Korba has the colonies of the power and coal companies. Both have large, well-kept grounds that suit a full outdoor gym. Raipur and Nava Raipur add new housing projects, government campuses and city gardens, while Bilaspur has schools, colleges and railway colonies. The forested Bastar region in the south has district towns and residential schools with open grounds.

sections.h: Heat, monsoon and the right set of machines
sections.html:
Central Chhattisgarh gets very hot from April to June, and the monsoon brings steady rain after that. Afternoon sun makes bare metal uncomfortable, so most people use an open gym early in the morning or after sunset. Put the stations under trees or near lighting, and lay a firm base that drains well after rain.

Townships with space often choose a 6 Station Multi Gym, which lets several people train in one footprint, plus a Cross Fit unit for younger users. Raipur buyers can see our outdoor gym page for Raipur. If you are also planning a children's area, see our playground equipment in Chhattisgarh.

faq.q: Can you supply a full outdoor gym for an industrial township?
faq.a: Yes. Share the ground size and the number of residents, and we will suggest a mix of multi-station and single machines. The layout drawing shows the clear space around each one before you approve the order.

faq.q: How is outdoor gym equipment installed in Chhattisgarh?
faq.a: Our team or a local dealer installs it, either grouted into concrete or self-standing on a prepared base. The method depends on your soil and whether the area is paved.

faq.q: Who do I contact for service after installation?
faq.a: Our after-sales team is on +91 738 530 0921 and aftersales@funplaysystems.com, Monday to Saturday from 9:00 AM to 6:30 PM. Send photos of the part and the site address.

intro: Haryana wraps around Delhi on three sides, and its cities have very different needs from an outdoor gym. Gurgaon has high-rise societies with landscaped podiums and clubhouses. Faridabad has an older industrial belt and large municipal parks. Sonipat, Rohtak and Bhiwani have colleges, universities and sports grounds, and Bhiwani in particular is known for its boxers. Karnal, Panipat and Ambala add schools, mandi towns and cantonment areas along the highway to Punjab.

FunPlay Systems supplies all of them. We build our Fun Fitness machines at our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, send them to Haryana by road and install them through our own team or a dealer in north India. Tell us whether your site is a society podium, a public park or a college ground, and we will suggest machines that match the users and the space. The proposal comes with a layout drawing that shows the clear area around every station.

sections.h: Dust, heat and fog: what to plan for
sections.html:
Haryana summers are very hot and dusty, and winter brings dense fog and cold nights. Galvanised frames handle both, but dust settles in moving parts, so wipe and check bearings regularly. Morning and evening are the busy hours, so plan lighting if people train before sunrise in winter. On a society podium, ask your structural engineer before grouting, or choose a self-standing base.

Gurgaon societies often pick an 8 Station Multi Gym to fit many users in a small corner. Colleges and sports grounds lean towards the Pull Up Station and a Ski Trainer. Gurgaon buyers can also read our outdoor gym page for Gurgaon, and for children see our playground equipment in Haryana.

faq.q: Can outdoor gym equipment be installed on a podium or terrace?
faq.a: Often yes, using a self-standing base so the slab is not drilled. Share the podium details and your engineer's load guidance, and we will suggest machines that suit it.

faq.q: Do you supply outdoor gyms to colleges and sports grounds in Haryana?
faq.a: Yes. Strength stations such as the Pull Up Station, Parallel Bar and Leg Press take heavy use from students and athletes. We can plan them beside an existing track or field.

faq.q: How long is the warranty on Fun Fitness machines?
faq.a: Three years on galvanised pipes and roto-moulded parts, and one year on springs, bearings and spare parts. It covers manufacturing defects when the machines are installed and looked after as per our guidance.

intro: FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor gym equipment to steel and coal townships, schools, colleges and municipal parks across Jharkhand. We make every Fun Fitness station at our factory in Vasai, near Mumbai, and transport it to Jharkhand by road. Installation is done by our own team or a dealer in eastern India, grouted or self-standing depending on the ground. The machines use body weight alone, so there are no motors or cables to look after.

Jamshedpur, Bokaro and Dhanbad have company townships with large parks and sports grounds, and these are often the first places in a town to add an open gym. Ranchi has colleges, government campuses and newer housing societies. Hazaribagh, Ramgarh and Medininagar have schools and public grounds where a small set of stations near a walking track gets regular use. We can plan for all of them, and a single layout drawing can cover a gym and a children's play area on the same ground.

sections.html:
Ranchi sits on the plateau and stays milder than the coal belt around Dhanbad, which gets very hot in summer. The whole state gets good monsoon rain. In coal and mining areas fine dust settles on equipment, so rinse the stations from time to time and check the moving parts. Lightning storms are common before the monsoon, so avoid placing the gym under a lone tall tree.

A township park can start with a Step Trainer, a Fun Rider and a Leg Extension, then add stations later. Each one stands on its own base. Jamshedpur buyers can see our outdoor gym page for Jamshedpur, and our playground equipment in Jharkhand covers the children's side.

faq.q: Is outdoor gym equipment suitable for dusty mining areas?
faq.a: Yes, with simple care. The galvanised frames and roto-moulded parts are weather-proof, but dust wears moving parts faster. Rinse the stations and check bearings more often than you would in a clean area.

faq.q: Can we add machines to our open gym in stages?
faq.a: Yes. Every station is installed on its own base, so a township or school can begin with a few machines and add more in the next budget cycle without changing the first ones.

faq.q: Do you install outdoor gyms in Ranchi and Jamshedpur?
faq.a: Yes. We deliver by road from Vasai and install through our team or a dealer near you. Send the site photos and rough measurements to start.

intro: Manipur has a strong sports culture, and many young people in Imphal and the valley towns train outdoors every day. An open air gym in a school ground, college campus or community field gives them strength stations to use alongside running and football. FunPlay Systems supplies these machines across the state, from Imphal to the district headquarters in the hills.

Our Fun Fitness range is built at our factory in Vasai, near Mumbai, and sent to Manipur by road. A local dealer or our own installation team then fixes the stations, grouted or self-standing depending on the ground. We also supply parks run by the municipal council, government offices and housing colonies. Send us the size of your site and the main users, and we will suggest a layout with the clear space for each machine marked. Each station stands on its own base, so you can add more as funds allow.

sections.h: Valley and hill sites in Manipur
sections.html:
Imphal lies in a valley ringed by hills. Summers are mild, winter mornings are cold, and the monsoon brings heavy rain. Low ground near lakes and rivers can stay wet, so choose a raised spot and give the base a slope. In the hill districts, level terraces work better than one long row. Plan the gym where it can be seen from a road or building, so it stays in use and is easy to watch over.

For training grounds, the Pull Up Station, the Parallel Bar Double and an ABB Trainer cover upper body and core. Imphal buyers can read our outdoor gym page for Imphal. For children, see our playground equipment in Manipur.

faq.q: Which outdoor gym machines suit athletes and sports students?
faq.a: Strength stations such as the Pull Up Station, Parallel Bar Double, Leg Press and ABB Trainer. They take heavy daily use and work well next to a field or track.

faq.q: Can you reach sites in the hill districts of Manipur?
faq.a: We send equipment by road to any site a truck can reach. Tell us the location and the road access, and we will plan the delivery and installation with you.

faq.q: What should we keep around each outdoor gym station?
faq.a: Leave clear space on all sides so one user does not hit another, especially around swinging machines. Our layout drawing marks this space for every station. Benches and planters should sit outside this zone.

intro: Few places in India are as wet as Meghalaya, and that shapes how an outdoor gym should be planned here. FunPlay Systems supplies Fun Fitness equipment to Shillong, Tura, Jowai and other towns in the Khasi, Jaintia and Garo Hills. We make the machines at our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, send them by road and install them through our team or a dealer in the region. Every station is checked at our in-house quality inspection before it leaves.

Buyers here are mostly schools, colleges, churches, community groups, government offices and town authorities. Tourist lodges and resorts outside Shillong ask for a few stations for guests as well. Shillong also has a long tradition of residential schools with big playing fields. On a hill site, the ground decides most of the plan. Send us photos and a rough sketch of the slope, and we will suggest machines that fit and show the clear space each one needs.

sections.h: Building an outdoor gym for heavy rain and cool weather
sections.html:
The monsoon in Meghalaya is long and very heavy, especially around Sohra, and Shillong stays cool for most of the year. Moss and wet leaves make bare concrete slippery, so use a textured or rubber surface around the stations. Galvanised frames resist rust, and roto-moulded parts do not absorb water. A covered spot, such as a shed or one of our gazebos, keeps the gym usable on wet days.

Good stations for cool, rainy sites include the Tai Chi wheel, the Shoulder Twirl and a Fun Walker Double. Shillong buyers can see our outdoor gym page for Shillong, and our playground equipment in Meghalaya covers children's areas.

faq.q: Can outdoor gym equipment stay outdoors through Meghalaya's monsoon?
faq.a: Yes. The frames are galvanised and the seats and grips are roto-moulded, both weather-proof. Clear moss and leaves from the base and check bearings after the rains to keep everything moving freely.

faq.q: Can we put the gym under a roof?
faq.a: Yes, as long as there is enough height and clear space around each machine, and air can move through so the area dries out. We also make gazebos and pergolas in our garden decor range if you need a covered structure.

faq.q: How do we start planning an open gym in Shillong?
faq.a: Share the site size, a few photos and who will use it. We suggest machines, send a layout drawing and a quote, and then manufacture and install once you approve.

intro: In Mizoram, flat land is the scarce resource. Aizawl and most towns are built along steep ridges. An outdoor gym often has to fit on a narrow terrace, a roadside strip or the edge of a church or school compound. FunPlay Systems supplies Fun Fitness machines for exactly these sites, with layouts drawn around the space you actually have. Lunglei and Champhai have the same ridge-top layout, so the same planning approach applies there.

We build the equipment at our factory in Vasai, near Mumbai, and send it to Mizoram by road. Our installation team or a local dealer fixes each station, grouted into concrete or self-standing on a prepared base. Buyers are mostly local councils, churches, schools, colleges and government departments. Many want a small set of machines first and more later, which works well because each station has its own base. Local football grounds are another good site, since players already gather there for training.

sections.h: Making the most of a narrow hill site
sections.html:
Combination machines save space on a tight terrace. The Chest Press Cum Shoulder Press and the Leg Press Cum Standing Twister each give two exercises on one frame. Place swinging machines away from the edge of a slope, and add a railing where the terrace drops away. Keep the main walking path clear so people can pass the stations safely.

Mizoram has a long monsoon with heavy rain, and hillside water can wash out loose bases. A grouted base with a drain behind it is usually the safer choice. Aizawl buyers can see our outdoor gym page for Aizawl, and for children see our playground equipment in Mizoram.

faq.q: What is the smallest outdoor gym you can plan?
faq.a: Even two or three stations make a useful start. Send us the length and width of your terrace or strip, and we will suggest compact or combination machines that fit with safe clear space.

faq.q: Is a grouted or self-standing base better on a slope?
faq.a: On sloping ground a grouted base is usually firmer, provided water can drain away behind it. Our team or dealer checks the site and confirms the method before installation.

faq.q: Can a church or local council order directly from FunPlay?
faq.a: Yes. Write to sales@funplaysystems.com or call +91 902 830 2266 with photos and measurements. We reply with suggested machines, a layout drawing and a quote.

intro: Nagaland has two quite different kinds of site. Kohima and the other hill towns are cool, steep and wet, while Dimapur sits on the plains and is warmer, flatter and busier. FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor gym equipment to both. We plan each layout around the ground you have, and the machine list changes with the site. Mokokchung, Wokha and other district towns follow the hill pattern of Kohima.

Our Fun Fitness machines are made at our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, and sent to Nagaland by road. A local dealer or our own team installs them, grouted or self-standing. Typical buyers are schools, colleges, churches, town councils, government departments and sports bodies. If you already have a playing field, a row of stations along one side is often the simplest way to begin. Share a sketch with the field's length and width and we will mark where each machine goes.

sections.h: Hill towns and the Dimapur plains
sections.html:
In Kohima, cut level pads for each station and give them drainage on the uphill side, since the monsoon brings heavy rain down the slopes. In Dimapur there is more flat ground, but summer afternoons are hot and humid, so shade matters more than slope. Plant trees on the west side of the gym or plan a simple shed so the afternoon sun does not heat the handles.

Stations that work for most age groups include the Seating Twister Three Way, which lets three people use one machine, the Fun Rower and a Leg Press. Kohima buyers can read our outdoor gym page for Kohima, and our playground equipment in Nagaland covers children's areas.

faq.q: Do you supply outdoor gym equipment to Dimapur?
faq.a: Yes. Dimapur and Kohima are both covered. The equipment is sent from our Vasai factory by road and installed by our team or a dealer in the region. Tell us the road access to your site when you share the photos.

faq.q: Which machine lets the most people exercise at once?
faq.a: Multi-user stations such as the Seating Twister Three Way or the 6 Station Multi Gym let several people train together on one frame. They save space on crowded grounds.

faq.q: What maintenance does an outdoor gym need in the hills?
faq.a: Check bolts and bearings after the monsoon, clear leaves and mud from the base, and report any worn part to our after-sales team on +91 738 530 0921.

intro: FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor gym equipment to towns across Sikkim, including Gangtok, Namchi and the smaller hill settlements. Our Fun Fitness machines are built at our factory in Vasai, near Mumbai, and come into Sikkim by road through Siliguri. Our installation team or a dealer in the region fixes them on your site, grouted or self-standing depending on the ground.

Buyers in Sikkim include schools, colleges, government departments, town authorities and the hotels and resorts that serve the state's visitors. A hotel can add a few stations on a lawn or terrace so guests can exercise with a mountain view. A school or a town park usually needs a larger set. Tell us the space and who will use it, and we will suggest a layout. We mark the clear area for each machine, which matters on narrow terraces with a drop on one side. Schools in Namchi and Gangtok often place the gym next to the assembly ground so it can double as a sports area.

sections.html:
Sikkim's monsoon is heavy and long, and landslides can close roads for days. We plan dispatch with you so the equipment reaches your town when the roads are open. Winters are cold in Gangtok and much colder in the north. Galvanised frames and roto-moulded parts handle both rain and cold, and grouting keeps stations firm on terraced ground. Pick a spot that gets morning sun, since shaded slopes stay damp and cold well into the day.

Gentle, low-impact machines suit hotels and older users, such as the Seating Twister Cum Tai Chi and the Fun Cycle. Gangtok buyers can see our outdoor gym page for Gangtok, and for children there is our playground equipment in Sikkim.

faq.q: Can a hotel in Sikkim add a small outdoor gym?
faq.a: Yes. Three or four low-impact stations on a lawn or terrace are enough for guests. Share photos and measurements and we will suggest machines and mark the clear space on a drawing.

faq.q: Will the equipment cope with Sikkim's cold winters?
faq.a: Yes. Galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic are weather-proof in rain and cold. Keep moving parts clear of ice and debris and check bearings at the start of each season.

faq.q: How is equipment delivered to Sikkim?
faq.a: We dispatch by road from our Vasai factory, and the truck enters Sikkim through Siliguri. We confirm timing with you, since monsoon landslides can close hill roads.

intro: FunPlay Systems makes outdoor gym equipment for parks, schools, colleges and housing areas in Tripura. Our machines use the person's own body weight and need no electricity, so they suit public spaces open from dawn. Our Fun Fitness machines are manufactured at our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, and travel to Tripura by road through Assam. Our own installation team or a local dealer then fixes them, grouted into concrete or self-standing on a prepared base.

Agartala is where most open gyms in the state get planned, in city parks run by the municipal corporation, in school and college grounds and beside lakes and walking paths. District towns such as Udaipur and Dharmanagar have school grounds and public parks that suit a smaller set of stations. Send us the size of your site and a few photos, and we will suggest machines and draw a layout with clear space around each one. Housing colonies on the edge of Agartala ask for gentler machines for older residents.

sections.h: Planning for a humid, rainy state
sections.html:
Tripura is warm and humid for much of the year, with heavy rain through the monsoon. Low-lying parks can hold water after a storm, so raise the gym area and slope it towards a drain. Our frames are galvanised and the seats and grips are roto-moulded, so they stand up to damp air. Trees help with shade, but keep falling branches and leaves away from moving parts.

A good first set for a city park is the Fun Walker Double, the Pendulum and a Chest Press Double. Agartala buyers can see our outdoor gym page for Agartala, and our playground equipment in Tripura covers the children's side.

faq.q: Do you install outdoor gym equipment outside Agartala?
faq.a: Yes. We deliver by road to district towns across Tripura, and installation is handled by our team or a dealer in the region. Share the town and site photos to get started.

faq.q: How much clear space does a Pendulum machine need?
faq.a: Swinging machines need more room than fixed ones, front and back. Our layout drawing marks the exact clear area for each station on your site before you confirm the order.

faq.q: What does the warranty cover?
faq.a: Manufacturing defects, for 3 years on galvanised pipes and roto-moulded parts and 1 year on springs, bearings and spare parts, provided the machines are installed and maintained as per our instructions.
